master.name: JEE Main
master.description: The unified entrance test for admission to NITs, IIITs, and other centrally funded technical institutions, also a qualifying exam for JEE Advanced. Syllabus based on NCERT Class 11 & 12.

Maths: Algebra (Complex Numbers, Quadratic Equations, Sequences & Series, Permutations & Combinations, Binomial Theorem, Matrices & Determinants)
Calculus (Limits, Continuity & Differentiability, Applications of Derivatives, Indefinite & Definite Integrals, Differential Equations)
Chemistry: Physical Chemistry (Atomic Structure, Chemical Bonding, States of Matter, Thermodynamics, Equilibrium, Electrochemistry, Chemical Kinetics)
Inorganic Chemistry (Periodicity, s-block, p-block, d-block, f-block, Coordination Compounds)
Organic Chemistry (Basic Principles, Hydrocarbons, Oxygen & Nitrogen containing compounds, Biomolecules, Polymers, Chemistry in Everyday Life)

satellites.name: BITSAT
satellites.deviation: Adds English Proficiency and Logical Reasoning. Focuses more on speed and accuracy due to negative marking and faster pace.

satellites.name: VITEEE
satellites.deviation: Includes an Aptitude section with specific sub-sections like English and Critical Thinking. Question level is generally considered easier than JEE Main.

master.name: NEET UG
master.description: The single entrance test for admission to MBBS/BDS/AYUSH courses in India, conducted by NTA.

Physics: Mechanics (Kinematics, Laws of Motion, Work, Power & Energy, Gravitation, Properties of Bulk Matter)
Electrodynamics (Electrostatics, Current Electricity, Magnetic Effects, EMI, AC)
Modern Physics (Dual Nature, Atoms, Nuclei, Electronic Devices)
Chemistry: Physical Chemistry (Some Basic Concepts, Atomic Structure, Chemical Bonding, States of Matter, Thermodynamics, Solutions, Equilibrium, Redox Reactions, Electrochemistry, Chemical Kinetics, Surface Chemistry)
Inorganic Chemistry (Classification of Elements, s-block, p-block, d-block, f-block, Coordination Compounds)
Organic Chemistry (Basic Principles, Hydrocarbons, Oxygen & Nitrogen containing compounds, Biomolecules, Polymers, Chemistry in Everyday Life)

satellites.name: AIIMS B.Sc. Nursing / Paramedical
satellites.deviation: Includes General Knowledge and Aptitude sections in addition to Physics, Chemistry, and Biology. Focuses on nursing and allied health professions.

master.name: CUET (Commerce)
master.description: Common University Entrance Test for admission to various undergraduate commerce programs in central and participating universities. Candidates select domain-specific subjects.

Accountancy: Accounting for Partnership Firms (Fundamentals, Reconstitution, Dissolution)
Economics: Microeconomics (Consumer Behaviour, Producer Behaviour, Market Forms)
Macroeconomics (National Income, Money & Banking, Government Budget, BoP)
Indian Economic Development (Development Experience, Reforms, Challenges)

satellites.name: IPMAT (IIM Indore/Rohtak)
satellites.deviation: Focuses heavily on Higher Mathematics (Quantitative Ability, including advanced topics like Functions, Logarithms, P&C, Probability beyond Class 12 standard) and Verbal Ability, alongside Logical Reasoning. Designed for integrated management programs.

satellites.name: SET (Symbiosis Entrance Test)
satellites.deviation: Covers General English, Quantitative Aptitude, General Awareness, and Analytical & Logical Reasoning. For BBA and other undergraduate programs at Symbiosis International University.

master.name: CUET (Arts)
master.description: Standardized test for admission to various undergraduate Arts/Humanities programs in central and participating universities. Candidates select domain-specific subjects.

Political Science: Indian Politics (Party System, Democratic Upsurge, Regional Aspirations)
Geography: India: People & Economy (Population, Human Settlements, Resources, Planning)
Geographical Perspective on Selected Issues and Problems

satellites.name: CLAT (Common Law Admission Test)
satellites.deviation: Completely different format: Legal Reasoning, Logical Reasoning, Current Affairs including General Knowledge, English Language, and Quantitative Techniques. Designed for 5-year Integrated LLB programs.

satellites.name: SET (Symbiosis Entrance Test - General)
satellites.deviation: Covers General English, Quantitative Aptitude, General Awareness, and Analytical & Logical Reasoning. For BA, BCA, and other undergraduate programs at Symbiosis International University.
